criteria.name: LLM Explanations & Prompt Engineering
criteria.guidance: Use well-designed prompts to explain validated model outputs while distinguishing prediction from fact and avoiding unsupported claims.

criteria.name: RAG: Ingestion/Retrieval/Grounding
criteria.guidance: Demonstrate document ingestion, chunking, retrieval and grounded answers with source citations.

criteria.name: Text-to-SQL & Query Safety
criteria.guidance: Generate schema-aware read-only SQL, validate queries and reject writes, destructive statements and multiple statements.

criteria.name: AI Agent Orchestration
criteria.guidance: Demonstrate meaningful routing and coordination among data, retrieval and explanation tools with error handling.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Responsible AI
criteria.guidance: Evaluate grounding, prompt injection, privacy, fairness, uncertainty and safe use; document test evidence and limitations.
